'''Pedorian''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that experienced a conflict known as the [[Pedorian Civil War]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] supplied weapons to both factions in the war.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Playing Both Sides}}</ref>
